overview: Memo weighs sending Commerce a Dairen despatch on Ordinance No. 324 on Kwantung industrial property, versus a Tokyo political despatch.

subfiles.title: Solicitor’s Office memorandum on transmitting industrial-property despatches to Commerce
subfiles.from: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Solicitor
subfiles.about: An internal memorandum asks whether the Department of Commerce should receive the Dairen consular despatch and enclosures concerning Japan’s Ordinance No. 324 for industrial property in the Kwantung Leased Territory.
subfiles.summary: Memo distinguishes Dairen's practical despatch from Tokyo's political despatch on Ordinance No. 324, suggesting the Dairen material alone suffices if Commerce is notified.

interest: Tracks a 1930 Kwantung industrial-property ordinance's distribution.
